update_pymupdf_table: update a docling TableItem by extracting fresh table data from a PyMuPDF page using its bounding box
extract_table_from_bbox: extract table data from a PyMuPDF page within a specified bounding box and return a TableData object
create_table_data: create a TableData object with rows, columns, and TableCell entries from extracted PDF table content
build_table_cells: build TableCell objects with text, spans, header flags, and bounding box coordinates from a PyMuPDF table
refactor_table_header_detection: refactor the table header detection logic to properly distinguish internal and external headers in PyMuPDF tables
